description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'NoShowUpdatedAuditActionService' that implements audit action handling for 'no show' updates in a booking system. It includes schema definitions, methods for data versioning, migration, display, and JSON serialization related to audit logs for no-show updates.

classes.name: NoShowUpdatedAuditActionService
classes.description: A service class for handling audit actions related to updates in 'no show' status within booking events.

methods.name: getVersionedData
methods.description: Returns versioned data based on input fields.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number from data.

methods.name: migrateToLatest
methods.description: Validates and migrates data to the latest schema version.

methods.name: getDataRequirements
methods.description: Extracts data requirements such as user UUIDs from stored data.

methods.name: getDisplayTitle
methods.description: Generates a display title for the audit log based on stored data.

methods.name: getDisplayFields
methods.description: Generates display fields for the audit log, including attendee and host no-show statuses.

methods.name: getDisplayJson
methods.description: Serializes stored data into a JSON format suitable for display.
